_comment: Managed CORE-plugin states for the LearningOS vault (ADR-006). install.py merges ONLY these keys into .obsidian/core-plugins.json — every other core plugin keeps whatever state Aram set. Rationale per key below; each is a boundary or usability decision, not a preference.

_rationale.webviewer: ON — 136 of the registered sources have URLs. The Source Explorer opens them in a tab instead of throwing the reader out of the app.
_rationale.daily-notes: OFF — the anti-goal list forbids a second inbox. work/inbox/ is the only capture surface (ARCHITECTURE 3.3.5); Daily Notes silently creates a competing one.
_rationale.bases: ON — the shelves in bases/ are installed by this project and are dead without it.
_rationale.canvas: ON — generated/concept-canvas.canvas is a generated view.
_rationale.properties: ON — frontmatter IS the canonical data; the properties editor is how a human reads it.
_rationale.graph: OFF — the concept canvas is the curated graph. Obsidian's link graph shows file links, which are NOT the OS's relation registry, so it invites reading a second, wrong graph (anti-goal: no competing graph system).
_rationale.sync: OFF — no Obsidian Sync account; git is the sync mechanism. Leaving it on advertises a second, conflicting one.
_rationale.zk-prefixer: OFF — filenames are ids assigned by the operator, never timestamps.
_rationale.markdown-importer: OFF — intake goes through work/inbox/ and the operator, not an importer.
